author: claude

requirement.text:
*   Shared storage permission: deny on startup, grant on startup, revoke
    *   You are not able to use the app when denying
    *   You can use the app when later accepting

routing.why: Android-only gate. Without all-files access, load() returns before super.load(), so the Capacitor WebView and the native log writers never start. This is what makes the app unusable while access is denied.
Native AlertDialog 'Allow shared file access', setCancelable(false) at line 105. OPEN SETTINGS opens ACTION_MANAGE_APP_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION and CLOSE APP calls finish().
When access is granted while the gate is waiting, the activity is recreated. This is the 'grant later' path, where the ET65 black-band layout defect appears.
Android-only special permission. Revoking it makes the OS kill the process ('MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE changed').

steps_note: back-test case: steps are authored for live runs in Step 3
